pre_command: osascript -e 'tell application "Obsidian" to quit' && sleep 2 && rm -rf ~/Documents/ResearchVault && mkdir -p ~/Documents/ResearchVault/.obsidian && printf '{"vaults":{"2c4dba47bc79f875":{"path":"%s/Documents/ResearchVault","ts":%s,"open":true}}}' "$HOME" "$(($(date +%s)*1000))" > ~/Library/Application\ Support/obsidian/obsidian.json && echo '# My Ideas' > ~/Documents/ResearchVault/Ideas.md
instruction: Inside ResearchVault, create a new note called "Links.md" that contains a wiki-link to "Ideas.md".
